name: the-seed
purpose: A handful of small files that grow verified software one cell at a time: a model writes each cell, code checks it down to an axiom floor the seed works out itself, a cell that proves out is sealed, and one that cannot is dissolved.

lane.accepts: a whole-number sum of + - and ×, with brackets, and a reply to it
lane.refuses: anything the floor cannot work out exactly: words, letters, division, fractions, or a reply with no whole number in it

interface.out: verified when the sum comes to exactly the whole number the reply ends on, unverified when it does not, refused when the sum or the reply cannot be read

judge.what: a reply is right when the sum, worked out in exact whole numbers with no rounding, equals the whole number the reply ends on
